description: Unit tests for the TestImporter class in the webkitpy.w3c.test_importer module, testing various methods including commit handling, description generation, and directory owner retrieval.

classes.name: TestImporterTest
classes.description: Test case class for testing the TestImporter functionalities.

methods.name: test_abort_on_exportable_commits
methods.description: Tests that the importer aborts when there are exportable but not exported commits.

methods.name: test_update_test_expectations
methods.description: Tests updating test expectations with renamed and deleted tests.

methods.name: test_commit_changes
methods.description: Tests that changes are committed with the correct git command.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the format of the commit message generated.

methods.name: test_cl_description_with_empty_environ
methods.description: Tests CL description generation with no environment variables set.

methods.name: test_cl_description_with_environ_variables
methods.description: Tests CL description with environment variables for build info.

methods.name: test_cl_description_moves_noexport_tag
methods.description: Ensures NOEXPORT tag is moved correctly in the description.

methods.name: test_cl_description_with_directory_owners
methods.description: Tests CL description including directory owners info.

methods.name: test_generate_manifest_command_not_found
methods.description: Tests behavior when manifest command is not found.

methods.name: test_generate_manifest_successful_run
methods.description: Tests successful invocation of the manifest generation script.

methods.name: test_get_directory_owners
methods.description: Tests extraction of directory owners from expectations file.

methods.name: test_get_directory_owners_no_changed_files
methods.description: Tests get_directory_owners when no files have changed.

methods.name: test_cc_part
methods.description: Tests the generation of CC command line arguments from directory owners.

methods.name: test_delete_orphaned_baselines
methods.description: Tests deletion of orphaned baseline files.
